source: Comparison page, not a genre guide: FIGURES.md's canon pass does not apply. The roster is the festivals that pass four stated tests (electronic core, DJ Mag Top 100 Festivals 2026 or a clear place in US electronic music, a US home edition expected in 2027 or a recent one, a distinct sound or setting). Ranks from djmag-festival-priorities.md (checked 15 September 2026).
note: Dates read on official sites or Insomniac's own pages on 2 October 2026; for festivals with a guide on this site, the guide's own sourced 2027 block was used. Images are Wikimedia Commons and new to this page: Electric Forest 2018 (FifthLegend, CC BY 2.0), Beyond Wonderland 2010 (Roxanna Salceda, CC BY-SA 2.0), III Points 2017 (Alienasomnia, CC BY-SA 4.0). A Lost Lands 2017 photograph (Drew Ressler, Commons licence 'Attribution') was left out because its licence terms are unclear. Set: Dusky live from CRSSD Fest, Fall 2018 (Mixmag channel, from the catalogue), oEmbed-checked 2026-10-02.
